## Byte-unit display preference

- Operator-facing byte counts and byte-per-second rates now use decimal
  `B`/`KB`/`MB`/`GB`/`TB` units by default.
- Personal preferences add a server-backed unit-system choice. Operators who
  prefer powers of 1024 can opt into `B`/`KiB`/`MiB`/`GiB`/`TiB` without
  changing stored values, API or CSV data, explicit configuration inputs, or
  bit-rate capacity units.
- The preference is applied consistently across Fleet, monitoring, storage,
  jobs, transfers, backups, topology, and audit views. Public monitoring shares
  use the decimal default because they have no authenticated operator context.
